data.title: Who pays for US power boom? Blue, red states offer starkly different ways to lower utility bills amid AI surge
data.description: New Jersey is requiring big data centers to shoulder more of their own power costs, while an Indiana utility says revenue from major new customers could cut household bills by about $100 a year.
data.keywords: energy, energy in america, mikie sherrill, smart and safe tech, energy planet earth, indiana, new jersey
